title: GTA 6 has more than 170 animal species
yt_title: How many animals are in GTA 6? 🐊 170+ species
description: How many animals are in GTA 6? Rockstar says Leonida has more than 170 animal species: about 60 birds and over 30 land mammals, plus fish and reptiles (Rockstar via Game Informer, reported by GameSpot). Tip: petting dogs and cats boosts your Focus (GamesRadar, Kotaku). Hunting reportedly rewards clean shots that keep the carcass pristine (unconfirmed). No spoilers. What's your favorite animal? Comment below.
rumor_note: Rumor (unconfirmed): hunting details (clean shots keep the carcass pristine for a buyer) come from wiki-style guides.

lines.text: How many animals are in GTA 6? Rockstar counts over 170 species.
lines.headline: 1/4 · WILDLIFE

lines.text: About 60 of them are birds, and more than 30 are land mammals, plus fish and reptiles.
lines.headline: 2/4 · THE MIX

scene.title: Of 170+ species
scene.note: Plus fish and reptiles · Rockstar via Game Informer

lines.text: In Rockstar's screenshots, you can spot iguanas in the Keys, alligators in the swamp, deer in the woods, and tropical fish.
lines.headline: 3/4 · WHO YOU'LL MEET

lines.text: Here's a tip: petting dogs and cats boosts your Focus. Just hold the left trigger near them first.
lines.headline: 4/4 · PET TIP

lines.text: And hunting reportedly rewards clean shots: a head or heart shot keeps the carcass pristine for a buyer.
lines.headline: HUNTING?

lines.text: Have you met them all? Comment your favorite animal.
